content.gate_framing: independently validated selective confidence/abstention gate; NOT an unknown-species detector
content.not_in_scope: No per-species exceptions. No geo dependency.
not_validated_for: CUDA or any non-CPU execution provider
retrained or re-exported artifacts (any artifact_hashes change invalidates this policy)
unknown-species detection (this is a selective confidence/abstention gate, not an out-of-catalog detector)
per-species thresholds (a single global threshold only)
population-level claims from the 260-image parity sample or the 65 x 6-row per-species independent-evaluation table
post-geo or rounded similarity scores (gate applies to raw, unrounded, pre-geo max cosine)

parity_report.note: Parity evidence generation recorded workspace_git_dirty=True -- carried through here verbatim, never concealed or reinterpreted. Parity is validated and bound, never rerun or rewritten by this generator.

contract.resize: squish to fixed 380x380 (both dims set, no crop)

executable_check.antialias_note: Both paths receive PIL Images and use Pillow bilinear resampling for the resize; torchvision's antialias option only affects its separate tensor-input code path and has no effect here -- confirmed empirically by max_abs_diff=0.0.
executable_check.covers: resize geometry/interpolation, /255 scaling, normalization, channel order, layout
executable_check.method: in-memory synthetic PIL image (non-square 517x241, seeded random RGBA pixels) run through training's build_transforms(train=False) [incl. .convert('RGB')] and api.AntIdentifier.preprocess() independently at generation time, no model inference

provenance.note: Diagnostic provenance only -- the API loader never reads or checks this block, so an edit to any of these files after this policy was generated does not retroactively deactivate an already-active gate. It DOES mean this policy's recorded provenance is stale relative to the current tree and the policy should be regenerated (via --write) before deployment. This applies equally to api/inference.py, whose only RUNTIME binding is the separate preprocessing.contract/executable_check fields above, not this hash.

rule.evaluated: raw pre-geo max cosine similarity, strict <, before any rounding
rule.signal: raw max cosine similarity before geo re-ranking
